environment.description: Same EC2 c5.large instance and binary. Process is launched inside a chroot(2) jail rooted at /opt/monolith/jail which contains only the binary, libc.so, libpthread.so, ld-linux.so, and /dev/null. The jail directory has no /proc, no /tmp with write permissions beyond a 64KB tmpfs mounted noexec+nosuid at /opt/monolith/jail/tmp, and no other files. The process runs as uid 65534 (nobody) with supplementary group drop. Filesystem namespace is unshared (CLONE_NEWNS) with MS_SLAVE propagation so no new mounts can be created inside. Additionally, a seccomp-bpf profile (applied before exec via a wrapper) restricts syscalls to: read, write, recv, send, accept, socket, bind, listen, close, mmap(PROT_READ|PROT_WRITE only, no PROT_EXEC), munmap, brk, clone(CLONE_THREAD only), futex, exit, exit_group, nanosleep, rt_sigaction, rt_sigprocmask. Notably mprotect is BLOCKED preventing any RWX page creation needed for shellcode execution after heap corruption.
